rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something fiercely or aggressively.

example.jyutping: keoi5 long4 sei2 gam3 naau6 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the aggressive manner is openly hostile, harsh, or threatening.

example.jyutping: keoi5 ok3 han2 han2 gam3 mong6 zyu6 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for aggressively pursuing an opportunity, target, or advantage rather than attacking someone.

example.traditional: 我哋好進取咁爭取呢個機會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hou2 zeon3 ceoi2 gam3 zang1 ceoi2 ni1 go3 gei1 wui6
